opportunities.name: Trip.com attraction search by city, keyword and sort, then open a listing
opportunities.description: Search Trip.com Attractions & Tickets for a keyword in a chosen destination city, sort the results, and open one listing.
steps: On the Trip.com home page, click the 'Attractions & Tickets' tab.
Click the Destination field and pick the city from the dropdown.
Click the Keywords field and type the search term.
On the results page, click the sort tab (for example 'Top Rated' or 'Lowest Price').
Click the activity title you want to open.
parameters: Sort tab (Top Rated or Lowest Price)

instances.values: Destination Hong Kong; keyword 'Park'; sort Top Rated; opened Shanghai Wild Animal Park.

Destination Seoul; keyword 'amusement park'; sort Lowest Price; opened Cerdon caves - Prehistoric Amusement Park. The listing click and the detail-page click come after a KOA task that was interleaved.

opportunities.name: KOA campground search by destination, dates and filters
opportunities.description: Search koa.com for campgrounds near a destination, optionally filtered by stay type and distance, and optionally with check-in and check-out dates.
steps: On the KOA home page, open the 'Filters' panel and tick the ways-to-stay checkbox you need (optional).
Set 'Max distance from your destination' if needed (optional).
Click the 'Where do you want to go?' field, type the destination, and pick the suggestion.
Click the Check In field and pick the date in the calendar (optional).
Click the Check Out field and pick the date in the calendar (optional).

instances.values: Destination Sacramento, CA; filter RV Site; max distance 250; no dates set.
Destination Lansing, MI; no filters; check-in 06/07/2023; check-out 06/12/2023.

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways baggage allowance lookup by cabin class
opportunities.description: Open the Qatar Airways baggage allowance page from the Experience menu and view the allowance for a chosen cabin class.
steps: Click 'Experience' in the Qatar Airways top navigation.
Click 'Baggage allowance' in the 'Before you fly' menu.
Click the cabin tab you need (Economy Class, Business Class or First Class).
Read the allowance table for that cabin.

instances.values: Cabin class Business. The Experience and Baggage clicks happened first, then the page was left open in a tab while other work was done before the Business tab was clicked.
